dispute_ticket.description: The taxi estimate was about S$25.60 but the receipt says S$32.00 and mentions a peak surcharge. It was 2pm, not rush hour. The driver also did not tell me the fare would go up and I was upset. Please refund the S$6.40.

app_events.details: Rider R-7112 booked a RydeTAXI (metered) trip RYDE-DS-012. Metered fare estimate S$25.60 (13.2 km, 28 min).
Trip completed. Distance 13.2 km, 28 min. Route matched recommended route.
Metered S$25.60 (flag-down S$4.00 + 13.2 km x S$1.00 + 28 min x S$0.30) + peak surcharge 25% S$6.40 = S$32.00 charged to credit card.
Receipt screen briefly showed 'fare unavailable' before loading.

fare_basis.value: metered: flag-down S$4.00 + S$1.00 per km + S$0.30 per minute
fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

peak_surcharge_percent.text: The percentage added to the metered fare for a trip that starts inside the peak surcharge windows.

peak_surcharge_windows.value: 06:00-09:30 and 17:00-20:00 daily, by trip start time
peak_surcharge_windows.text: States the times of day at which the peak surcharge applies.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: Ryde taxi fares are metered, and the metered part is correct: S$4.00 + 13.2 km x S$1.00 + 28 min x S$0.30 = S$25.60, matching distance, time and route. But the trip started at 14:05, outside this trip's peak surcharge windows (06:00-09:30 and 17:00-20:00), so the 25% surcharge of S$6.40 should not have been added. The full S$6.40 is refunded; the driver's silence and the receipt glitch are irrelevant to this.
